descriptionHtml: The very first annual general meeting of IEEE ComSoc student Branch Chapter was successfully held appointing a new enthusiastic group of people for the committee. Dr. Himal Suraweera was appointed as the advisor. Malsha Koswathta was appointed as the chair, Tharika Liyanage as the Vice Chair and Shamil Ihalagedara as the Secretary of the student branch Chapter.
